L-Q8.title: What led you to this Privacy Form today?

L-Q1.ui:toolTip: Report any incidents involving Personal Information (PI)—like loss, unauthorized access, or privacy complaints—immediately. If not, select 'No' to continue.

L-Q2.ui:toolTip: Describe your need or the support you’re seeking from the team.

L-Q3.ui:toolTip: Specify the main issue or question you would like assistance with.

L-Q4.ui:toolTip: Before starting any work involving Personal Information (PI), complete a privacy review as required. Identify all PI types involved using the definitions and classification chart found on LillyNow. Check if your objective can be met without PI or with anonymized data. Review the Respecting Privacy Procedure to ensure you understand privacy principles, plan for privacy controls through the full lifecycle, and document how PI will be collected, used, stored, transferred, and retained. Use the Privacy by Design and PI Lifecycle Data Flow job aids for guidance.

L-Q5.ui:toolTip: Describe your project, PI use, locations, timing, processes, purpose, and third-party involvement to help us match you to the right privacy expert.

L-Q6.ui:toolTip: Identify the Lilly EVP/M7 leading PI use for this project—usually the exec responsible for project goals, budget, or corrective actions. Check org info if unsure.

L-Q7.ui:toolTip: Upload a file, document, or image to help us with your issue. Emails must be saved as PDFs first—print the email to PDF, then upload the saved file here.
